data.title: How Market Payments and Recommendations Work Today

questions.tip: Let them describe their work in their own words before asking about settlement.
questions.question: Tell me about your role in market trading or supporting market members, and how you handle payments after a trade.

questions.tip: Ask for the most recent example and clarify each step and timing.
questions.question: Walk me through the last trade where payment was completed, from the trade being agreed to the money being received.

questions.tip: Ask what caused the delay, what they did next, and what it cost them.
questions.question: Tell me about the last time payment took longer than you expected.

questions.tip: Look for actions they took, including services used and money spent.
questions.question: What have you done in the past to receive or make payment faster?

questions.tip: Ask how much they paid, why they paid it, and whether they would do it again.
questions.question: Tell me about the last time you paid a fee to speed up, secure, or simplify a payment.

questions.tip: Ask them to describe a recent decision rather than their general opinion.
questions.question: How do you decide whether a new payment or settlement service is worth using?

questions.tip: Ask what led to the recommendation, how it was shared, and what happened afterward.
questions.question: For association leaders, tell me about the last time your association recommended a service to its members.

questions.tip: Ask for a specific example and listen for concerns about trust, liability, effort, or member response.
questions.question: What has made it difficult for your association to recommend a payment or settlement service in the past?
